audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes never name World Ender, The Darkin Blade or Umbral Dash and give no cooldown numbers, so the level-6 and 2-item warnings are vague.
audit.why: World Ender is 120/100/80s and extends on takedown; Umbral Dash is 9/8/7/6/5s and carries the heal-on-damage passive. Naming both makes the spike advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten to name World Ender (120s at rank 1) at level 6 and the Darkin Blade rotation at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry never names a single Aatrox ability, and it never states the decisive interaction: Aegis Assault only blocks damage from the FRONT and is a channel that Aatrox's third Darkin Blade swing knocks up and cancels.
audit.why: Riot's own text for Aegis Assault: Pantheon 'becomes invulnerable to damage from the front' and the kit flags it as a channel that any CC cancels. Aatrox's Q is a three-swing sequence on a 14s rank-1 cooldown. Facing him is the whole skill expression of the matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Aegis Assault blocks the front only — face The Darkin Blade so the sweetspot knockup does not cancel the channel.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns listed no numbers at all.
audit.why: Real values: World Ender 120/100/80, Umbral Dash 9/8/7/6/5, Shield Vault 13/12/11/10/9, Grand Starfall 180/165/150.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block now carries the four numbers that decide when to fight.

notes: _missing-interactions.json claims 'Aatrox can cancel your Aegis Assault (E) with World Ender (R)'. Riot's own World Ender text only fears nearby enemy MINIONS — it applies no champion CC, so that claim is a derived-flag misfire and I did not write it. The real channel-breaker is the third Darkin Blade swing's sweetspot knockup. Same file flags Infernal Chains as 'grounding' and says it denies Shield Vault and Grand Starfall; Riot's description only describes a drag-to-centre and re-damage, never grounding, so I did not assert dash denial either — logged in unverified.
